## Engineering Integrity Checklist
- [ ] My calculations are mathematically defensible and referenced if complex.
- [ ] I have not fabricated missing information (e.g., assuming 0 downtime when null).
- [ ] Error messages are actionable and guide the user on how to fix their data.
- [ ] I have included deterministic unit tests for any new reliability metric.
- [ ] I have updated the Explain Mode (if applicable) so the user can audit the calculation.
- [ ] The code is clean, typed, and follows the existing architecture.
